english.notes:
(i) The relevant offensive weapons to which this section applies are listed in the Schedule 1 to the Criminal Justice Act 1988 (Offensive Weapons) Order 1988.
(ii) This section does not apply to any weapon subject to the Firearms Act 1968 or to crossbows (section 141(2)).
(iii) 'Private' is defined in section 141(1C) as a place other than a public place, school premises, further education premises or a prison.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H1728, H1729, H1730, H1731, H1732 and H1733.
(v) Defences are available under section 141(5), (7A), (8A), (9) and (11ZA).
(vi) The HO Code for this offence was originally 195/20, but has been changed to 197/21, to allow it to be tracked as a notifiable offence.
